WITH cte AS (
  SELECT 
    b.beneregistry,
    b.benedistref,
    b.benefeedbackscore,
    b.distequityidx,
    b.commengagelvl,
    b.localcapacitygrowth,
    b.vulnerabilityreview,
    c.stakeholdersatisf,
    CASE 
      WHEN b.commengagelvl = 'Low' THEN 1
      WHEN b.commengagelvl = 'Medium' THEN 2
      WHEN b.commengagelvl = 'High' THEN 3
      ELSE 0
    END AS commengage_numeric,
    -- BSI calculation
    b.benefeedbackscore * 10 + (CASE 
      WHEN b.commengagelvl = 'Low' THEN 1
      WHEN b.commengagelvl = 'Medium' THEN 2
      WHEN b.commengagelvl = 'High' THEN 3
      ELSE 0
    END) * 20 + b.distequityidx * 50 AS BSI
  FROM beneficiariesandassessments b
  JOIN coordinationandevaluation c ON b.beneopsref = c.coordopsref AND b.benedistref = c.coorddistref
),
cte_with_cee AS (
  SELECT 
    *,
    -- CEE calculation
    CAST(BSI AS numeric) / 100 * commengage_numeric * ((stakeholdersatisf + 1) / 5.0) AS CEE
  FROM cte
)
SELECT 
  beneregistry,
  benedistref,
  ROUND(CEE::numeric, 2) AS CEE_score,
  CASE 
    WHEN localcapacitygrowth = 'Active' AND commengagelvl = 'High' AND BSI > 70 THEN 'Community Resilience Builder'
    WHEN CEE > 2.5 AND vulnerabilityreview = 'Complete' AND NOT (localcapacitygrowth = 'Active' AND commengagelvl = 'High' AND BSI > 70) THEN 'Community Resilience Opportunity'
    ELSE 'Standard Operation'
  END AS classification
FROM cte_with_cee
ORDER BY classification, CEE DESC;
